scripts.pre-preinstall: pnpx only-allow@1.2.2 pnpm && node -e "if(process.env.HEXCLAVE_SKIP_TEMPLATE_GENERATION !== 'true') require('child_process').execSync('pnpm exec tsx ./scripts/generate-sdks.ts', {stdio: 'inherit'})"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm pre && pnpm typecheck:anti-slop && turbo typecheck --
scripts.build:dev: pnpm pre && NODE_ENV=development pnpm run build
scripts.cli: pnpm pre && turbo run build --filter=@hexclave/cli && pnpm run cli:no-build
scripts.cli:no-build: pnpm pre && echo && echo && echo '[CLI output starts below]' && echo && echo && HEXCLAVE_API_URL=http://localhost:${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}02 HEXCLAVE_DASHBOARD_URL=http://localhost:${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}01 HEXCLAVE_CLI_PUBLISHABLE_CLIENT_KEY=this-publishable-client-key-is-for-local-development-only node packages/cli/dist/index.js
scripts.build:docs: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run codegen && pnpm run build:backend && turbo run build --filter=@hexclave/docs-mintlify
scripts.clean: pnpm pre-no-codegen && turbo run --concurrency 1 clean && rimraf --glob **/.next && rimraf --glob **/.turbo && rimraf .turbo && rimraf --glob **/node_modules && rimraf node_modules
scripts.uff-cutie: pnpm clean && pnpm i && (pnpm build || true) && pnpm codegen
scripts.codegen: pnpm pre && turbo run codegen && pnpm run generate-sdks && pnpm run generate-setup-prompt-docs
scripts.stop-deps: POSTGRES_DELAY_MS=0 pnpm run deps-compose kill && POSTGRES_DELAY_MS=0 pnpm run deps-compose down -v
scripts.wait-until-postgres-is-ready:pg_isready: until pg_isready -h localhost -p ${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}28 && pg_isready -h localhost -p ${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}34; do sleep 1; done
scripts.wait-until-postgres-is-ready: command -v pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1 && pnpm run wait-until-postgres-is-ready:pg_isready || sleep 10
scripts.wait-until-clickhouse-is-ready: echo 'Waiting for ClickHouse to be ready...' && pnpm exec wait-on -t 10000 -v http-get://localhost:${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}36/ping || echo 'ClickHouse is not ready after 10 seconds (this is probably a problem with our wait-on setup TODO fix), continuing regardless...'
scripts.start-deps:no-delay: pnpm pre && pnpm run deps-compose up --detach --build && pnpm run wait-until-postgres-is-ready && pnpm run wait-until-clickhouse-is-ready && pnpm run db:init && pnpm run reseed-bulldozer && echo "\nDependencies started in the background as Docker containers. 'pnpm run stop-deps' to stop them"
scripts.restart-deps: pnpm pre && pnpm run stop-deps && pnpm run start-deps
scripts.restart-deps:no-delay: pnpm pre && pnpm run stop-deps && pnpm run start-deps:no-delay
scripts.restart-deps:with-tests: pnpm run restart-deps && pnpm test run auto-migrations/migration-tests
scripts.explain-query:
pnpm pre && echo 'Paste your query (end with Ctrl-D):' && query=$(cat) && echo 'Connecting to Postgres...' && printf "EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, COSTS, VERBOSE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
$query" | pnpm run --silent psql -qAt | sed -n '/\[/,$p' > explained-query.untracked.json && echo 'Explained query saved to explained-query.untracked.json. To analyze it, open it in the query analyzer at https://tatiyants.com/pev/#/plans/new'
scripts.dev:full: pnpm pre && concurrently -k "pnpm run build-packages:watch" "pnpm run generate-sdks:watch" "pnpm run generate-setup-prompt-docs:watch" "turbo run dev --concurrency 99999"
scripts.dev: pnpm pre && HEXCLAVE_DEV_UI=stream pnpm run dev:tasks
scripts.dev:tui: pnpm pre && HEXCLAVE_DEV_UI=tui pnpm run dev:tasks
scripts.dev:tasks: pnpm run check-deps && turbo run dev build-packages:watch generate-sdks:watch generate-openapi-docs:watch generate-setup-prompt-docs:watch --ui ${HEXCLAVE_DEV_UI:?HEXCLAVE_DEV_UI must be set} --concurrency 99999 --filter=// --filter=./apps/* --filter=@hexclave/docs-mintlify --filter=./packages/* --filter=./examples/demo --filter=./examples/tanstack-start-demo
scripts.dev:inspect: pnpm pre && STACK_BACKEND_DEV_EXTRA_ARGS="--inspect" pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:basic: pnpm pre && concurrently -k "pnpm run build-packages:watch" "pnpm run generate-sdks:watch" "turbo run dev --concurrency 99999 --filter=@hexclave/backend --filter=@hexclave/bulldozer-js --filter=@hexclave/mcp --filter=@hexclave/dashboard --filter=@hexclave/mock-oauth-server"
scripts.dev:docs: pnpm pre && concurrently -k "pnpm run generate-setup-prompt-docs:watch" "turbo run dev --concurrency 99999 --filter=@hexclave/docs-mintlify"
scripts.dev:named: pnpm pre && concurrently -k "pnpm run dev" "node -e \"process.title='node (stack-named-dev-server)'; process.stdin.resume();\""
scripts.kill-dev:named: (pgrep -f 'stack-named-dev-server' | xargs -r -n1 pkill -P); echo 'Killed named dev server (if found). Sleeping to give some time for it to shut down...' && sleep 10
scripts.kms: PREFIX=${NEXT_PUBLIC_HEXCLAVE_PORT_PREFIX:-81}; for p in 00 01 02 03 04 06 14 42 43 44 45 46; do pids=$(lsof -i :$PREFIX$p 2>/dev/null | grep LISTEN | awk '$1 != "OrbStack" {print $2}' | sort -u); [ -n "$pids" ] && echo $pids | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; done; echo Done.
scripts.verify-data-integrity: pnpm pre && pnpm -C apps/backend run verify-data-integrity
scripts.generate-openapi-docs:watch: pnpm exec tsx ./scripts/wait-for-dev-package-imports.ts && pnpm run --filter=@hexclave/backend codegen-docs && chokidar --silent -c 'pnpm run --filter=@hexclave/backend codegen-docs' './apps/backend/src/app/api/latest/**/route.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}' './apps/backend/src/lib/openapi.ts' './packages/shared/src/interface/webhooks.ts' --throttle 2000
scripts.generate-setup-prompt-docs:watch: pnpm run generate-setup-prompt-docs && chokidar --silent -c 'pnpm run generate-setup-prompt-docs' './docs-mintlify/docs.json' './packages/shared/src/ai/unified-prompts/**/*.ts' './scripts/generate-setup-prompt-docs.ts' --throttle 2000
scripts.build-packages:watch: tsdown --workspace='packages/*' && pnpm -C packages/dashboard-ui-components run build-iife && pnpm -C packages/dashboard-ui-components run copy-iife && tsdown --workspace='packages/*' --watch
